headline: Oil, Gas Breaks Through 70 Euros. Barrel Rally Resumes as Trump Meets Big Oil
summary: Crude is above $90 a barrel and European gas has passed 70 euros, reaching peaks not seen in almost six months. The report links the rally to resumed hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz.
why: European gas prices reflect the continent's dependence on imported energy, and Middle East disruptions feed into both oil and gas prices.
why_moved: Resumed hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz raised supply-risk premiums across oil and gas.
